page.overview:
What is Marowak?

There is a deceased Marowak who haunts the sixth floor of the Pokémon Tower in the Generation I games and their remakes. A non-playable character in Lavender Town tells the player that the Marowak is the mother of a Cubone, and reveals that the Marowak was killed by Team Rocket while trying to protect her Cubone from them, since Team Rocket wanted to sell the skulls of Cubones for a high price.

The Marowak is the main reason why the Silph Scope is required, in order to access the seventh and uppermost floor of the Pokémon Tower. Like the other wild Pokémon, the Marowak appears as an unidentifiable ghost without the Silph Scope. It is not possible to catch the Marowak.
